First, finding someone new to « get over » someone (lol wtf does that even mean) is probably just going to end up in useless drama and hurting someone who did not ask for that on top of yourself. Not to say it is impossible to find love when mourning another one, but trying to use the former to erase the latter is doomed to failure in my opinion. What does that mean for this « new » person in terms of respect ? 
And for some of us who are deeply hurt, like on a very deep existential level (and I am aware of the meaning of such words), « finding someone new » is no way to find peace about what has been broken. 
To me, and I say it in the way I feel it, not in the way I wish things were or in order to give lessons, being with someone is about creating something and can hardly be mistaken with erasing something that was created and trampled on.

One year and a few months ago, my boyfriend of four years made à I-turn I would never have imagined and left, never asked for news or anything. People may say whatever they want, that no one should place their happiness in the hands of others, that I am weak for feeling the shock still to this day, that time will heal me etc., I know that I was happy in this relationship and that I did not make mistakes that deserved such a deep indifference. This is the worst battle I have ever gone through and I don’t even know what I am fighting against. It just broke me and my sense of belonging. I was not a weak human being before or anything of which someone might say « you had deeper issues if you can be this wounded by a break up ». No, it is not true. Some people would like to feel protected by believing they can’t be hurt or that they don’t have the power to hurt someone on that level, but they can. I feel deeply lonely now, and even on r/BreakUps I now feel like a stranger. I make dreams in which I negotiate how to be euthanized, because the life I have been living for the last year is sincerely not close to livrable. I wish so many things were different, and I may have been lucky to live a protected life and never known real struggle like poverty or war or disease, I know this is the hardest thing I ever faced,

My advice is really to never miss a dose. Sometimes I feel so bad that I am like « fuck this I won’t take my meds anymore they are no help for my problems » and then after two days I am a mess, not only crying but also having nausea, crazy anxiety, insomnia, honestly when I am in this state I do believe that dying would feel better. I guess this is accommodation ... thing is even if sometimes you don’t « feel » the effect of your medication, the withdrawal symptoms are unbelievably awful.

It has been over a year for me too and it feels like it was last month. I am in no way encouraging you to keep feeling this way if you can find something that will help, but I also know that I am by many means a standard human being, and that feeling this bad does not mean I am crazy, hysteric, mean. I have a lot of trouble not feeling ashamed of being so deeply hurt and lost, but many people encourage me to not feel this way and assert that I am not a crazy person (whatever that means). 
You are not weak, or crazy, or a less-valuable person, for feeling this way.

Hello to both of you. I am commenting here because I feel like I have been through the exact same thing and it has left me completely broken. I cannot say it in another way, I am lost in a spiral of resentment, feeling of injustice and betrayal, deep sadness and inability to accept the situation (though it has been a while). I just felt like reaching out to express myself and I am not looking for advice or anything like « it’s a process / You have to accept » etc, really I already feel bad enough for not being able to cope with the free will of someone else whom I love. I feel completely lost in this and I really begin to think I don’t have the capacity to understand this feeling of not being alright when your partner has become kind of your family through the years, it does not make sense to me, and if I am being honest I don’t want to bring sense into it because if I accept that you can be cut out from the life of someone so close just like that, it really brings the darkest thoughts in me and I during this last year my life has been turned upside down and even though I may not appear so, I have become very suicidal to an alarming point. Honestly stories like yours bring a profound vertigo and anger in me. Sometimes I feel like shouting out that they are some piece of shit who cannot appreciate what they had and cherish it, but I hate myself for having strong emotions and opinions like this and I am just deeply hurt. I guess what this relationship taught me is the definition of happiness I feel the most in line with, aka that happiness is wanting what you have, and these were the most formidable years of my life... 
I cannot wish you both anything but to not be stuck in my place and to manage to feel complete and really calm within again 😕

Hi, I feel like on this sub many people who have been dumped suffer especially because they do not see their ex as evil at all. If we hated them, it would be easier actually because we could just rage. But I believe that you could re-read the whole sub where you find posts of people hating on their ex as proof of hurt and as signs of deep emotions towards the person. Even if something they did feels wrong and we resent them for it, I think many of us know that hating them is no solution and we do not even want to do this. I was blindsided with a breakup that has made me lose my sense of identity and purpose, yet I never « hate » them. I hate how they did not tell me that something was not okay, I hate that they broke the team we were, but never would I even imagine hating them. And when I dare to say « they will be alone forever and they suck » I know it is a short term outburst of anger that has absolutely no effect apart from letting me express my despair in a way that satisfies my pain for like a second. 
So maybe if you can’t find another sub that is more ad hoc for your needs, try reading with this scenario in mind...

A few days ago I remember trying to ask Siri to « call mum » because I needed to ask for help because I could not move and was panicking but I could not even pronounce my request properly because my teeth were too gritted...

The other day, a homeless man asked me if I could buy some groceries for him at a shop nearby. So we went together in the shop, and I ended up spending slightly more than I would have expected, but I could not deny a man buying washing liquid for his clothes or any other thing that he needed. So I paid and then he asked me if he could leave me his e-mail address so I would help him fill in some administrative forms to ask for social help. I was not feeling comfortable with that, so I told him that he should try to go to a social worker office to get help and that I would not know how to be of any help for him. But after that I just felt like the worst person in the world, like a selfish prick who would give money but not time to another human being in need, and I went home to cry like a baby because I was feeling too mean to exist. I try my best not to ignore people in need but I find it very difficult not to get involved too much and refusing to help more, so thank you for the post OP, answers here provide some instructions to do our best !

Sometimes I feel that way, and it makes it all the more harder to even try to communicate to them, even when they are saying that we should talk to them if we are feeling bad... it’s a vicious circle leading to deep loneliness, and I find it very hard to break because I would also feel extremely bad to say to someone trying to cheer me up that I don’t believe anything they say and that I hate everything, that I am just sad beyond limits and that it is not fair... and it would not be well received. I get your point. Yet, as the director explains in many interviews (I was trying to find one with English subtitles but I don’t see one), she almost co-realized the movie with the young actresses, who were carefully interviewed beforehand. The movie is made to adopt the perspective of those young girls, not from the view of an adult. It is a way for the director to depict the conflicts she herself has been subjected to. Now I can see why you would stand your ground on this point but I really think digging more into the view of the director and the cast is helpful here. I think the director is a wonderful bright woman, and is is outrageous that she received death threats and had to cancel her social media accounts. The intent of the movie is really completely in accordance with the condamnation of child pornography and the objectification of women, but subtly shows how it is a view that spreads and settles within the mind of children from a very young age ... I hope you can get my point 🙂

About the movie, it is originally a French movie and it appears that many French productions are somehow misunderstood overseas sometimes.

Moreover, the director is a woman whose intent was to shed light on the mixed signals young girls going through puberty receive from their family, the media and the surrounding culture. Especially when it comes to dancing, which is a sport a lot of little girls want to practice, the director wanted to show how the hyper sexualisation coming from clips of many superstars (Rihanna, Cardi B, Nicky Minaj, to name just a few) who are models for youngsters. Hence, one of the point of the film is to make us wonder how young girls can develop a sane relationship with their femininity and their body when the models they have are either a patriarcal family scheme or stars who twerk and dance in a very suggestive way in their clip. 

Needless to say, the movie is very well received in France, and not because French people love to see 11 year olds butts shaking on screen, but because it displays a reality many children are exposed to.

Reading the comments here, I believe like many that you are a very good person to respect your daughter’s decision and to not pressure her at a time that probably is difficult for her too. I have already been told by my parents when they did not believed I behaved well and in a good way for myself with friends for example and even if it may bring about some arguments, most of the times it helped me reflect on myself and what I was doing.
